title: Mountains Scene 7 — Mountain Journey
purpose: Journey sequencing, route language and observation.

sentenceModels: They are walking along the mountain path.
The goat is on the rock.
The path goes past the flowers.
They are going up the mountain.

adultSupport.focus: Describe a journey with first/next and simple route language.
starterPrompts: Are they going up or down?
expansionPrompts: Tell me the journey from the bottom of the path upward.
What should they follow to stay on the path?

visualAudit: Reviewed in Wave 3 Batch 2 automatic pass against the visible teaching targets.
